conclusion: No contradiction to the existing narrow header-package code-absence assessment was found in these changed vendor references. This is an inference requiring separate exact current CNA and payload identity checks; it is not approval of any policy.
limits: CNA raw byte comparisons are recorded separately. No new manual review of all 182 kernel patches is claimed.
The pages may list kernel headers among an overall source-package rebuild; that alone does not establish that the affected implementation is shipped in the exact Ubuntu linux-libc-dev payload.
Ubuntu H/C severities remain unchanged; vendor severity changes are not grounds for suppressing Ubuntu findings.
The executing host kernel remains unverified and a privileged container is not a VM boundary.
